result.detail: Each customer creates own API token in dashboard (API Tokens > New Token) and sends it via x-api-token header. No vendor review, approval, verification or listing step found. No install/user/server cap for unreviewed apps stated. OAuth 2.1 appears only in the Scalekit integration page; no review step described there either. Marketplace is a catalog of prebuilt scrapers, not an app store. Docs are silent on app review, not explicit; subagent did not read /docs/api/overview.
